_what: Members of the vesting SCOPE-GATE bucket READ by hand on 2026-11-24, with the verdict and the cause. The scope gate is lib-4i.mjs's `if (!strictGate && !employerMoney && !universal && !wholeAcctOnly) continue;` whose false verdict runs BEFORE every quote fallback, so a refused filing stores nothing at all.
_why: `vesting-quote-ceiling.mjs` reported 2,868 plans / 5.39M readers GATED and called it the largest addressable class. It is a POPULATION, not a defect: the gate exists to refuse a vesting claim about EMPLOYEE money, which is vested by law. These readings are what separate the two, and three successive readings each REFUTED the previous bucketing — so the list is the record of what was actually looked at rather than a classifier's output.
_how_to_use: A ship widening this gate must keep every `refuse` member refused and should reach the `defect` members. Pin by ACK and make a miss THROW: a pin keyed on a shared STRING does not identify a plan.
_derive: node scripts/vesting-gate-census.mjs  (buckets) · --show MAYWRONG_DRAW --lim N --seed S (seeded draw) · scripts/vesting-gate-read.mjs (every refused sentence per plan)

published_termination_counterfactual._what: A SEPARATE finding, store-side and exact: plans whose PUBLISHED vesting sentence is the §411(d)(3) plan-termination counterfactual, with NO label above it — so the quote is the whole answer. Derive with `node scripts/vesting-termination-quote.mjs`.
published_termination_counterfactual._remedy: NOT withdrawal. lib-quote.mjs's own settled position on the sibling acceleration-only class is that withholding would publish "not stated in the audited notes" about a filing that DID state something, so the shipped remedy there is a HEDGING SENTENCE beside the quote. Measured: `accelerationOnlyVesting` fires on 0 of these 10, so the page prints them bare.
published_termination_counterfactual._do_not: Do not widen the EXPORTED `AV_TRIGGER` to carry plan termination. v211's scope gate imports it, so that would change parser LABELS as a side effect — a safety argument belongs to a MECHANISM, not to the file it happens to sit in.
